# Google "G" logo (third-party trademark)

- `google-g.svg`: downloaded unmodified on 2026-10-24 from Google's own CDN
  https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/ui/2.0.0/images/auth/google.svg
  (the asset Google's FirebaseUI sign-in buttons use). © Google.
- Same mark as the official sign-in branding assets:
  https://developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines
- Use only on the "Continue with Google" button, following Google's sign-in branding guidelines
  (do not recolour, stretch or redraw it). In the Flutter app, use the official asset from the guidelines.
